## Summary

What does this pull request change and why?

## Contribution type

- [ ] Documentation / research reference
- [ ] Taxonomy / schema
- [ ] Synthetic dataset record

## Data and safety review (complete for any data or taxonomy change)

- [ ] No victim evidence, personal data, credentials, financial identifiers, private conversations, or live malicious URLs are included.
- [ ] Examples are synthetic or appropriately cited public-source abstractions.
- [ ] Source rights and licence have been checked.
- [ ] Provenance, confidence, and limitations are documented.
- [ ] Re-identification and misuse risk have been considered.
- [ ] I have read the Data Governance Policy.

## Validation

- [ ] `python scripts/validate_records.py` passes (where relevant).
- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests` passes.
- [ ] Documentation has been updated.

## Reviewer notes

List any unresolved questions, regional/language limitations, or conflicts of interest.
